goal: Implement, test, and ship the keyboard shortcuts that docs-accuracy-audit phase 1 removed from docs.md as aspirational-but-unbuilt, alongside the shortcuts already implemented and documented, as one reconciled set.

phases.goal: One shortcut-dispatch mechanism exists and is proven: useKeyboard is wired into the app shell, both currently-working shortcuts are migrated onto it with no behavior change, and the hook itself finally has test coverage.
definition_of_done: cmd: pnpm --filter web test -- useKeyboard passes
cmd: pnpm --filter web test passes (full suite — existing Cmd+K and list-nav behavior tests, if any, still pass unchanged)
prose: apps/web/src/features/command-center/hooks/useCommandPalette.ts no longer contains its own document.addEventListener('keydown', ...) block

phases.goal: C, R, and F work: compose, reply, and forward are keyboard-accessible.
definition_of_done: cmd: pnpm --filter web test passes, including new tests asserting each of C/R/F triggers its action and is a no-op with nothing focused where that applies
prose: all three are registered through the phase-0 useKeyboard instance, not a new ad hoc listener

phases.goal: E, #, and Cmd+Shift+A work: archive, delete, and select-all are keyboard-accessible.
definition_of_done: cmd: pnpm --filter web test passes, including new tests asserting archive/delete fire the same mutation the click UI fires, and select-all selects every currently-visible row

phases.goal: Cmd+, and ? work: settings is keyboard-accessible, and a help surface documents the live shortcut set.
definition_of_done: cmd: pnpm --filter web test passes, including new tests asserting Cmd+, navigates to settings and ? opens the help surface
prose: the help panel's shortcut list is sourced from the same registry the hook dispatches from, not a hand-maintained duplicate

phases.goal: docs/user-guide.md's Keyboard Shortcuts table is complete and accurate again — this time verifiably, not just by inspection.
definition_of_done: prose: every shortcut key present in the phase-0..3 useKeyboard registrations has a corresponding row in docs/user-guide.md's table, and vice versa — verified by the verification script's output, not by eye
cmd: just lint (or the docs-only subset: markdownlint) passes
grep:absent: click/tap-only today in the Keyboard Shortcuts section of docs/user-guide.md (the caveat this pipeline makes obsolete)
